1.explanation:
• table/index.en-us.md & table/index.md: these files define the public API for Table and Column, including how dataIndex is described in the documentation and what patterns are officially supported.
• table/demo/basic-columns.md: shows the simplest usage of dataIndex with flat keys, matching the working scenario (‘time’ column).
• table/demo/column.md: demonstrates nested and single‐level array‐access notation (e.g. lists[1].name), which uses the same fetchDataByPath implementation and highlights where bracket notation is expected to work.
• table/demo/advanced.md: contains advanced Table demos and may hint at deeper dataIndex patterns. It helps confirm what syntax is currently supported.
• table/adaptor/index.jsx: this is the core implementation of fetchDataByPath and the regex logic that splits the key. Editing this file is necessary to adjust the bracket notation parsing and fix the bug.
1.bug_scenario:
The Table component’s “dataIndex” property currently supports simple keys (e.g. 'id'), nested paths with dot-notation (e.g. 'user.name') and single‐level array access (e.g. 'lists[1].name'), but does not handle bracketed array notation that contains commas—specifically strings like '[start,end]'. In the screenshots we see:

• A developer asks for compatibility with dataIndex strings of the form '[start,end]', to map a single column to two values (startDate and endDate) for form-based editing.
• In the render demo, <Table.Column title="Time" dataIndex="time" /> works fine, but when dataIndex="[start,end]" is used, fetchDataByPath in the Table adaptor tries to match /(.*)\[(.*)\]/ and splits into two parts, but the comma inside prevents correct capture of two distinct keys. As a result, val becomes undefined and later code attempts to read .startDate and .endDate from undefined, throwing “Cannot read property 'startDate, endDate' of undefined”.

Key elements involved:
- Table.Column dataIndex prop
- fetchDataByPath utility in table/adaptor/index.jsx
- The regex match and object lookup logic for bracket notation
- API docs and demos showing dataIndex usage
